text:
Neal Pionk went undrafted out of Minnesota-Duluth and just played his 600th NHL game, celebrating it with two goals against Tampa Bay. He has four goals and 11 points in 17 games while playing 24 minutes a night, almost all of it in a losing stretch: Winnipeg lost seven straight before back-to-back wins over Montreal and Vancouver.

His own scoring is running hot. Last season he scored three goals in 51 games, and his current 1.61 points per 60 is well above his talent range (0.74 to 1.23). Shooting 9.5 percent as a defenseman will come down.

Here's the twist: his teammates' shooting has gone the other way. Winnipeg has scored 6 fewer goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice. So the totals may hold even as the goals slow. The real worry is defensive. Evolving-Hockey had opponents getting more chances with him on last season, bottom 8 percent among defensemen, and Winnipeg is under 50 percent of expected goals at 5v5 with him out there now.
headline: Pionk keeps scoring as the Jets keep chasing
